title: Three Inches
lead_cast: Noah ReidJames MarstersKyle SchmidStephanie JacobsenNaoko MoriJulian RichingsCraig EldridgeAntony Del Rio
premise_summary: Three Inches is an American science fiction action television special, intended to serve as the pilot episode for a proposed series. Created by writer-producer Harley Peyton and directed by Jace Alexander, Three Inches aired on Syfy on December 29, 2011. The television special follows a group of people with superhuman abilities, focusing on Walter Spackman, played by Noah Reid, an underachiever who develops a telekinetic ability after being struck by lightning.
